Case reference: 2006009799.CaseDesc: On May 25, 1974, Francis Foster, Robert Warren and another friend departed for a canoe trip on Basswood Lake, Quetico Park, 45 miles (72 km) south of Atikokan, Ontario. It is believed that the canoe overturned and all three are presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2010005899.CaseDesc: Mark Edmonson disappeared from his residence in Stoney Creek on October 3, 1999. Mark has not returned or contacted his family members since that time and both his family and Police are concerned for his well being. Mark is developmentally challenged. It is believed that Mark left home without taking any money or personal identification. Extensive police searches have failed to determine his whereabouts.

Pants: Blue, Jeans with hole in left knee

Case reference: 2013000022.CaseDesc: Shenchiu "Andy" Tsou was last seen at the Halifax Casino on June 26, 2005 in Nova Scotia. He was known as a regular client at the casino. Andy was travelling from Richmond, British Colombia.

Case reference: 2014002370.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Kelvin Zdarski and two friends left Dauphin, Manitoba and drove to a cabin near Waterhen, Manitoba. During the evening there was an argument between the men. Kelvin left the cabin and never returned. The men looked for him on their way back to Dauphin but did not see him. On June 17, around 7:30am, a man fitting Kelvin's description was seen walking on a local road. An extensive search by land, air and water proved unsuccessful. Kelvin did not take his wallet, money or identification with him and had no means of transportation.

Scar: Left Calf, 1 inch long, back of calf

Case reference: 2014002740.CaseDesc: On November 17th, 1997, Ferdinand Dauz was last seen in New Westminster British Columbia.  Mr. Dauz was despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014002864.CaseDesc: Mark Garland was reported missing on November 26, 1996, to the Durham Regional Police Service.  It is believed that he went missing from Toronto, Ontario and foul play has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2014005293.CaseDesc: On the morning of January 20, 1999, Abdol Hossein was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Scar: Cheek, Welts all over his face and cheek

Case reference: 2014000018.CaseDesc: On March 10, 2001, Dawn Rees was seen for the last time in Calgary, Alberta. During the time of her disappearance, Dawn was leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014005006.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2007, Sun Jin, her husband Joon Han, and their daughter Il Han were seen for the last time at a school in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016069147.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1974, the body of a Caucasian male was found on the CNR tracks, 200 yards west of the CNR Station, Hearst, Ontario. A witness observed the remains on the tracks after an advancing train had passed. His post-mortem length was recorded as being 5’8” however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He was described as having a medium build. He may have been wearing glasses according to police reports.

Teeth: Good, Missing upper left 3rd molar. Several of his upper and lower posterior teeth had amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2019053661.CaseDesc:
On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2016064545.CaseDesc: On May 17, 2007, skeletal remains of a man were discovered in a farmer's field near the Athabasca River, in Alberta. It is possible that these remains came from the river. This individual did not have any upper teeth and likely wore dentures. The sacrum was deformed and there is a possibility that he walked with a limp.

Case reference: 2014002692.CaseDesc: Between September 3 and October 3, 1978, Jean-Jacques Sirois was seen for the last time in the Rosemont District in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-Jacques has not been seen or heard from since.

Jewelry: Gold, Gold ring with rectangular cubic zirconia

Case reference: 2014001684.CaseDesc: On June 30th, 1974 Brent Forsyth was 11 years of age when he went missing while fishing along the Bulkley River by Two Mile Creek in Hazelton BC. Brent was last seen upriver fishing a back-eddy. As a result of Brent's disappearance an extensive search involving community members, search and rescue, RCMP Police Dog Services and RCMP air service entailed. Despite these efforts and continued investigations he has never been located. Police have received new information about Brent and are seeking anyone who might have additional information about Brent's disappearance to come forward.

Deformity: Nick on the top right ear

Case reference: 2020009419.CaseDesc: On August 6, 1989, at approximately 12:00pm, Jessica Sakouhi was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Jessica was visiting from France and was due to return back on August 19, but she did not board the plane.

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 113 lbs, however this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Case reference: 2014003643.CaseDesc: Dean Mortensen was reported missing on January 24, 1992, after he failed to attend his classes at the University of Alberta in Edmonton, Alberta. Dean was last seen by his friends leaving the on campus bar, The Ship. They parted ways with him within 200 metres of his dorm room at the St. Joseph's College that night.

Jacket: Grande Cache Bantam Elks leather hockey jacket with gold shoulders, white collar, "Dean" on sleeve
Shirt: ST JOSEPH, St. Joseph crest on front

Case reference: 2016008425.CaseDesc: Colleen Sylvia Smith was last seen at home, on February 9, 2016, by her ex-boyfriend/landlord.

Case reference: 2014005505.CaseDesc: Forrest Schab was last seen on August 13th 2010 in Mexico City, Mexico.

Tattoo: Left Arm, Symbol of Rolls Royce
Left Upper Arm, Two aliens wearing suits
Right Arm, Upper arm, portrait of his sister

Case reference: 1996006630.CaseDesc: Adam, Mitchell and Trevor O'Brien have been reported missing since November 9, 1996 from Mount Pearl, Newfoundland & Labrador. The three brothers may be in the company of their father.

Case reference: 2010006399.CaseDesc: Glen Wesley, a patient at the Northeast Mental Health Hospital, was granted permission to leave the facility on his birthday. Staff believes he went to downtown North Bay. Glen didn't return and was noticed missing at approximately 2:15 PM. He suffers from Schizophrenia which requires medication. Since his disappearance there have been several unconfirmed sightings of Glen in the Cochrane, Timmins and New Liskeard areas.

Case reference: 2014004400.CaseDesc: Deoclides Santos was last seen on November 27, 2003, in Kitchener, Ontario, by his son.

Case reference: 2014005155.CaseDesc: Harold Murray Harvey was seen for the last time by a neighbour in front of his residence in Pincourt, Quebec on September 14, 2008. Harold was reported missing by a family member on September 19, 2008. At the time of his disappearance Harold was taking medication, which he left behind. Harold had a history of leaving his home in the past but always returned after a couple of days.

Case reference: 2012020126.CaseDesc: Rollande Doherty was last seen around 2:30 P.M. on February 2, 2007 near the library in Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014042438.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2014, at approximately 6:00 p.m., Delaram Hashemi was seen for the last time leaving her home in Toronto, Ontario. Delaram had told her mother that she would be attending a party and would return home at 10:00 p.m., but she never returned.

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2014002868.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1989, Ronald Jack last spoke with his mother. During that telephone discussion, Ronald had informed her that he and his wife, Doreen Jack, would be leaving for a “camp job”. He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2014003086.CaseDesc: On January 30, 1997, Maurizio Di Caprio was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. Maurizio left for Chicoutimi, Quebec or Toronto, Ontario to bring back a vehicle to Montreal.

Case reference: 2014004617.CaseDesc: Richard Deren was last seen in Vancouver on March 12, 2005. He disappeared and neither his family nor friends had heard from him. This was unusual behaviour for him not to keep in contact with his friends.

Case reference: 2014004143.CaseDesc: Ruth Clarke was last seen in the High Park district of Edmonton, Alberta, on November 1, 1990. She was reported missing to the police on November 12, 1990. She left her cane, glasses and daily heart medication at home. Ruth is known to visit the communities of Lloydminster, Killam, Leduc and Kananaskis in Alberta.

Case reference: 2024031172.CaseDesc: Lorraine Maltais-Chonkolay was last seen by her family on June 15, 2024, in Dene Tha' First Nation Bushe River, in MacKenzie County, Alberta, before leaving their family home early in the morning. Lorraine has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2017010385.CaseDesc: On September 26, 2015, at approximately 2:00 p.m., Fadi Zakir was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2008004699.CaseDesc: Adave Francis was last seen at 6:00 p.m. on October 13, 1999, riding his bicycle on the farm property located at Poplar Sideroad in the Collingwood, Ontario area. Adave was a seasonal worker from Jamaica.

Case reference: 2006023199.CaseDesc: Kenneth Churney was last seen in March of 1997. He was on a snowmobile travelling northbound toward the trail system head at the rear of Pine Crescent. He never returned from snowmobiling and may have been feeling despondent.

Deformity: Left Ring Finger, 0.5 of an inch shorter

Case reference: 2014002983.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1986, Joseph Major was reported missing from a care home in the Hudson Bay District of Saskatchewan. Extensive ground searches of the area failed to locate Joseph.

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2013000083.CaseDesc: On December 4, 1999, Jean-René Duguay was seen for the last time when he was seen jumping off the Lachapelle Bridge in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-René’s body was never found.

Case reference: 2013000094.CaseDesc: Robert Beauchamp was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on June 22, 1993. Robert left his home with friends and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014002231.CaseDesc: On September 25, 1980, Heinz Gamper was seen for the last time when he went mountain climbing in Jasper National Park in Jasper, Alberta. Following this time, Heinz was scheduled to work, but he did not attend his scheduled shift.

Case reference: 2013000017.CaseDesc: In August 1983, Jannisina "Jan" Stonehouse left her home in Oakville and has not been seen since. She may have left home due to being pregnant.  Jannisina may have been in the company of Darlene Tucker who is also missing. Refer to case 1993001330

Teeth: Good, Four teeth treated (one tooth had partial nerve treatment), one tooth absent lower left jaw. Dental chart on file.

Case reference: 2012020101.CaseDesc: William Gill was last seen in the early morning hours of December 21, 1981, leaving an apartment on Appleby Drive in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. William had been out earlier that evening with a co-worker. It is very unusual for William to be out of contact with his family, particularly before Christmas.

Case reference: 2018023712.CaseDesc: On May 1, 2018, Elsa Vargas was last seen near her home in Chateauguay, Quebec.  Elsa's vehicle remained parked in the driveway but nobody was home.  Elsa has citizenship in Costa Rica and speaks Spanish, French and English and her disappearance is contradictory to her usual behaviour.

Mark: Right Cheek, Mole on the right side

Case reference: 2012020131.CaseDesc: Gilles Parisien was reported missing on October 28, 2003 from Malartic, Quebec. At the time of his disappearance, Gilles was at the Malartic Hospital Center.

Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Teeth: Missing several teeth; had a great deal of restorative work done in the past with multiple silver-amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2014001814.CaseDesc: On October 27, 1973, between 2:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m., Steve Mysick packed a suitcase and left the residence where he was staying in Rapid City, Manitoba. At the time of his disappearance, he was an outpatient of the Brandon Mental Hospital and had been staying with a friend. Steve was last seen at the CP train station in Brandon, Manitoba. It is possible that he bought a ticket to Winnipeg as he had very limited funds and had lived in Winnipeg in the past. There is no indication if he actually boarded the train to Winnipeg. Steve's whereabouts remain unknown. No foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2014029389.CaseDesc: Jed Ouillette was last seen on the afternoon of September 8 2014 in the Kitchener area of Ontario. His identity documents were left at his home. Jed had lost his drivers licence due to medical conditions, including seizures, and was also experiencing financial difficulties.

Shirt: Design on the front with short sleeves and a collar.
Shorts: White, Other, Above the knees and has belt loops.

Case reference: 2014001314.CaseDesc: On May 2, 1981, Verna Bjerky was seen for the last time hitchhiking from Hope to Kamloops, British Columbia. She was carrying roller skates over her shoulder and was seen getting into a vehicle with a lone occupant. Verna has not been seen or heard from since.

Hair: Blonde, Long, Long blonde hair with short bangs
Shirt: Red, White, Red with white flowers
Shoes: Canvas, Brown, "North Star" Brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2014001708.CaseDesc: Marlene Abigosis was last seen in March of 1984 in the downtown east side of Vancouver. Marlene was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. Marlene was known to work near the docks, and clients that owned boats would take Marlene with them on trips to Washington State and Vancouver Island on occasion.

Case reference: 2014005145.CaseDesc: Sometime after July 30, 1939, Charles "Henry" Baxter went missing from the Hawarden District, SK. At the time of his disappearance, it was thought that Charles "Henry" went across the river to Tichfield to find work, or even joined the military and went overseas. However, Charles "Henry" was never seen again by his family, and these theories have never been substantiated.

Case reference: 2023053313.CaseDesc: Kyle Hancock was last seen in St. Thomas, Ontario, on August 2, 2023. Kyle's phone hasn't been connected to any network since he was last observed, and his bank account hasn't been accessed.

Case reference: 2014005815.CaseDesc: On June 18, 2012, at 4:30 p.m., the Regina Police Service received a call from Floyd Kakakaway. He told them that his brother Frederick (Fred) Kakakaway was missing. Floyd stated that he had last seen Fred early on June 14, 2012, at 6 a.m. Fred had told Floyd that he was heading to the Regent Park Safeway to look for recyclable cans. He has so far failed to return home and there has been no trace of him since that time. Fred is diabetic.

Deformity: Right Leg, Walks with a slight limp
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, A cross, forks and a heart
Left Upper Arm, Heart and ribbon with text "FRED"

Case reference: 2014005457.CaseDesc: On July 7, 2010, Roosdianajati and Didik Harijanto were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Roosdianajati and Didik were scheduled to work, but did not show up for their shifts.

Case reference: 2014005315.CaseDesc: Darryl Dubitski was last seen by his family leaving his residence in Edmonton, Alberta in December of 1982. Darryl had informed his family that he was travelling to the United States.

Case reference: 2006012899.CaseDesc: Delmar Henderson was last seen in the area of Burnt River (Kinmount), Ontario on June 2, 1983.

Case reference: 2014005549.CaseDesc: At the end of September 2010, Dustin McMillan left Edmonton to drive to Ontario. Police have not been able to confirm where and when Dustin was last seen but he never made it to his final destination.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, High TI style tattoo

Case reference: 2006023699.CaseDesc: Jeffrey Turtle was last seen in Pikangikum in the Squirrel Rock area in Ontario on July 4, 2005. Information received indicated that Jeffrey was going to a sand pit area approximately 3 km northwest of Pikangikum.

Hat: Blue, Red, Ball Cap, Red "C", Size Large
Sweater: Hooded, Size XL, Black, Red And White

Case reference: 2014006329.CaseDesc: On November 22, 2013, David Czerman was taken to Surrey Memorial Hospital for substance impairment.  Later that day, David discharged himself from the hospital and was given a bus ticket at approximately 19:40 hours. He has not been seen by his neighbours or family since November 21, 2013.  David was depressed and on pain medication for a medical condition.  Family described David as a recluse, with no friends and only left his residence to go to the local pharmacy as he had trouble walking.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Dragon, Rose, bones skull
Left Forearm, Smurf, eagle, worm, heart
Right Forearm, Wizard, devil, rose, bird

Case reference: 2014001028.CaseDesc: The body of this middle aged man was found in the Fraser River near Quesnel, British Columbia on May 20, 1968. He was well dressed and had custom orthotic supports in his shoes. He would have been born around 1920, had grey hair and likely had full dentures.

Other: Case, Leather case with nail clippers
Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Pen Knife, Pen Knife
Leather, Black, Small key case with 15 keys
Shoes: Leather, Black, Pointed dress shoe with Dr.Scholl's arch support insole
Wallet: Brown, Light brown leather wallet with dark brown stitching

Case reference: 2021030286.CaseDesc: On May 13, 2021, Mona Hu was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Mona had been in contact with her family in China, and was arranging to travel to see them.

Case reference: 2013000007.CaseDesc: Kimberly Ann McAndrew has been missing since August 12, 1989 from Halifax, Nova Scotia. At 4:20 P.M. that day, she left the Canadian Tire on 6203 Quinpool Road where she was employed as a cashier. There were unconfirmed reports that Kimberly was last seen at the Gardenia Flower Shop in Penhorn Mall in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia. Kimberly was identified by an employee at the flower shop as having bought a balloon and a rose.

Shoes: Jade green, flat heeled slip on loafers

Case reference: 2014004122.CaseDesc: Maria Evangelista was last seen on January 27, 1997, in Montreal, Quebec. Maria had called her mother to tell her that she no longer wanted to return to the hospital and would like to work in California, United States of America. Maria's luggage was found in a hotel in San Francisco, California, USA, on February 7, 1997.

Case reference: 2015063998.CaseDesc: On October 6, 2015, Erin McGonigal was last seen leaving her home. Erin's home is located in the area of Dundas Street and Cawthra Road, Mississauga, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020008557.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1984, at approximately 10:00 am, Rodolf Scoulde was last seen leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Rodolf was on his way to a nearby store.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Sword and heart with the word "COCO"

Case reference: 2012020170.CaseDesc: An adult male was washed up along the south side of the beach at Stanley Park, near the 2000 block of Beach Avenue at English Bay in Vancouver.

Wallet: Black, Contained pliers and a jack knife
Mark: Forehead, Post mortem abrasion on the right side of the forehead

Case reference: 2019072428.CaseDesc: In April of 2019, Corey Baldwin was seen for the last time in Ottawa, Ontario. It is out of character for Corey not to contact his father for an extended period of time. It is possible that Corey may be in British Columbia or Montreal, Quebec.

Lower Back, Surgical scar, horseshoe shape on the tailbone

Left Arm, Sleeve with a graffiti wreath
Right Arm, Cartoon wolf with a police hat

Left Upper Arm, Inside left bicep written "I love her"

Case reference: 2021050906.CaseDesc: On September 19, 2012, at approximately 8:30 p.m., Gregory Mish was last seen near the American Falls, in the area of Prospect Point, Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Gregory was despondent.

Scar: Head, 2 x 3 x 2-inch scar in the shape of a Z above the left side of his ear

Case reference: 2014005069.CaseDesc: On February 27, 2008, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Kien Hua was seen for the last time by his friend in Toronto, Ontario. Kien had told his friend that he was going to borrow his parents' car and was leaving town for a couple of days. On March 4, 2008, his parents' vehicle was found abandoned in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002218.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1977, Arthur Roy was seen for the last time, at approximately 1400hrs, when he left his home on foot in North Bay, Ontario. Arthur was suffering from a mental illness and was believed to be senile due to old age.

Case reference: 2014001046.CaseDesc: On July 23, 1990, the body of this middle-aged man was found on Gore Avenue in Vancouver, British Columbia. He died of complications related to chronic alcohol dependence.

Hair: Blonde, Long dark blonde hair with greying beard
Jacket: Denim, Blue, Young Life Creator brand
Shoes: Grey, Nike Air brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2014003900.CaseDesc: On December 8, 1977 at approximately 3 p.m., Ronald Foucault left his father’s business located in the city of Blainville, Quebec and told his father he had to travel to Texas, in the United States for work. There has been no news from Ronald since this time and it is impossible to confirm his arrival in the United States. In 1979, some of his belongings were found near the Dorval airport in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002401.CaseDesc: Winifred Jane Smith, better known as Jane, was a student at Laurentian University in Sudbury, Ontario. She was last seen on August 9, 1975, in her apartment just before she retired for the night at 2:00 a.m. The following day, she was not seen or heard from, and she was reported missing. Her personal belongings were left behind. There is evidence to suggest that Jane's disappearance may be a result of foul play.

Scar: Forehead, Small round scar between the eyebrows

Case reference: 2006021199.CaseDesc: Guy Labreche and Ricky Dechaine were last seen at the airport in Sioux Lookout, Ontario on September 12 1987, as they departed on a return flight to Thunder Bay, Ontario. It is presumed that Guy, the aircraft pilot, lost control of his Cessna.

Case reference: 2018054180.CaseDesc: On May 8, 1992, John Leonard was seen for the last time when he borrowed a friend's vehicle.  Later that same day, the vehicle was recovered at Woodbine Racetrack in Toronto.

Shoes: Nylon, White, Running shoes with a low cut style
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Pair of dice

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2021001787.CaseDesc: On January 10, 2021, Sébastien Lavallée was seen for the last time when he left his residence. Sébastien had mentioned that he was going to go for a walk on the lake in the ‘MRC des Deux-Montagnes’ in Quebec. During the time of his disappearance, Sébastien was engaged in a high-risk lifestyle, and was suffering from mental health problems.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Implant retained dentures, upper and lower

Case reference: 2021039122.CaseDesc: Robert Heard was last seen in June 1961, walking in the forest near his farm located on Pothole Road in Eby Township, Ontario. Robert was showing signs of reduced cognitive function during the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004864.CaseDesc: On November 6, 2006, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Ahmed Moalin-Mohamed was seen for the last time as he left his apartment to search for employment in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002363.CaseDesc: On January 7, 1997, Darcy Puddicomb was seen for the last time. He departed his residence that morning with the intention of attending work. He did not arrive.

Case reference: 2006012999.CaseDesc: Joshua Kennett was last seen in the water following the capsizing of the vessel he was travelling in on Grayson Lake, Ontario, on 13 October 1995. It is presumed that Joshua drowned.

Case reference: 2020008533.CaseDesc: On January 15, 1982, at approximately 7:30 am, Jona Rashid was last seen on Weston Road in Toronto, Ontario. Jona had called his sister in law at 5:30pm and stated that he would be coming over for dinner.

Case reference: 2018063460.CaseDesc: On October 13, 1992, at approximately 8:30 am, Debra Kumar was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002090.CaseDesc: On February 28, 2000, Stephane Levesque was seen for the last time at his home in the Verdun district of Montreal, Quebec. Stephane went to move his car from one side of the street to the other, and he never came back. Car keys belonging to Stephane were found in his vehicle.

Coat: Black, Winter coat with "Skidoo" written in yellow

Case reference: 2014003748.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1996, the police were contacted by a friend who reported that three of his hunting partners, including Glen Mymryk, had been missing from a hunting trip. The three men left in a loaded boat and reached halfway to their destination when they decided the water conditions were too challenging and they turned around. The men were bailing, but the waves were too much for them to handle. The motor stalled and they capsized. Glen was last seen floating away soon after the boat capsized. The sole survivor was rescued seven hours after the incident, at which point it was ascertained that the other two men had drowned.

Case reference: 2024040404.CaseDesc: George Guilbeault was last seen leaving his home in North Cobalt (Haileybury), Ontario at approximately 8:30 pm on August 2, 2024 in his vehicle towing his boat.  The next morning, George's boat was found unattended on Lake Temiskaming, on the Quebec side of the lake.  Police found George's vehicle and empty boat trailer at the boat launch.  An extensive search effort by the Ontario Provincial Police and the Sûreté du Québec, including air and marine units and the OPP's Underwater Search and Recovery Unit, was conducted with no success.

Case reference: 2010003999.CaseDesc: During the evening of Friday May 28, 1999, Tammy Lamondin, age 20,  was with friends on Main Street in Newmarket. She remained in their company until sometime after midnight. In the early morning hours of May 29, 1999, Tammy left the Newmarket area with a male acquaintance. She was not seen again. The police conducted an investigation but were not able to locate her.

Tattoo: Right Ankle, Dolphin above right ankle

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2000000830.CaseDesc: On July 22, 1990, Charlene Catholique was seen for the last time hitchhiking at the intersection of Highway 3 and Rae Access road in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories.

Case reference: 2014005708.CaseDesc: On October 9, 1959, Martin Kenny and his cousin rode an Algoma Central Railway freight train from Sault Ste. Marie to Hawk Junction, Ontario, to visit his parents. The train came to a stop in Eton at Mile 120, leaving the train car they were riding in behind. Martin failed to reboard the train and was left behind. Martin was last seen in Perry, Ontario, on October 10, 1959. He stopped for water before walking north along the railroad tracks. He was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014005112.CaseDesc: Tian You Li left his extended family home in East Vancouver to go for his routine walk. He never returned. He suffers from Alzheimers and may be confused and disorientated.

Case reference: 2020010925.CaseDesc: On October 2, 1990, Mabel Wong was seen for the last time, at approximately 10:30pm, as she left her residence in Toronto, Ontario. It is believed that Mabel left her home to go meet someone. Her vehicle was found approximately two kilometers from her home.

Shoes: Leather, Black, CASUAL, with metal tips

Case reference: 2012020129.CaseDesc: Nadine Lussier and Dominic Gauthier worked at a convenience store in Sainte-Sophie, Quebec. They were seen for the last time on June 16, 2004. They left the convenience store around 3:00 p.m., and were then seen in a Prévost, Quebec area restaurant. Nadine's vehicle had not moved from the restaurant between the evening of June 16, 2004 and the time Dominic Gauthier's mother reported their disappearance on June 18, 2004.
